system.description:
Now the alchemist reaches into the substance of an element itself, shifting its very nature a few steps along the ladder of creation.

Mutate produces minor shifts in composition, changing a given element into another up to five greater or five lesser than its original place on the Periodic Table. You must first know every element in the compound (at least two levels of Science or Science: Chemistry) and work in a laboratory; Alchemy does not work on animate ideals. The process takes one hour per level of Alchemy and ends in a Static Mental Challenge at the Storyteller's discretion. Retest with Science.
